how_title: How the review management system works
how_intro: A clear summary of Filtra.AI: from collecting customer feedback to protecting your reputation, including Google Reviews and AI-assisted replies.
how_purpose_p1: Filtra.AI strengthens positive digital presence and handles complaints discreetly. Positive reviews go to Google; dissatisfaction stays under internal control.
how_purpose_p2: Your team can analyze issues, fix processes and respond before unwanted public exposure.
how_s1_p: After activation you get a unique link and QR Code for counter, menu, packaging or WhatsApp. The first step stays in your controlled environment.
how_s2_p: The customer rates 1 to 5 stars. The system then chooses the next path automatically.
how_s3_p: Scores of 4 or 5 are positive: the customer is sent to your official Google page. Final posting depends on the customer confirming on Google.
how_s4_p: Scores of 3 or below stay on your dashboard with no automatic redirect to Google, so management can handle the issue privately.
how_s5_p: For negative feedback, AI suggests an empathetic reply and tags. Plans with reports also get period analysis.
how_s6_p: The panel gathers reviews, private complaints, metrics, alerts and operational links (page, widget, QR).
how_s7_p: 7-day trial with no card. Then pick a plan and pay. Cancel anytime; access lasts until the end of the paid period.
how_sum_high: Scores 4–5: customer guided to Google Reviews.
how_sum_low: Scores 1–3: private feedback on the dashboard, with AI suggestions.
how_footer: Filtra.AI does not replace Google Reviews; it guides positive experiences there and protects the business when there is dissatisfaction.
